statement: The Arrival suite runs in CI as shards (SHARD=k/n node test.mjs): the shards together run every case exactly once, the heavy case (about 85 minutes alone) is shard 0 by itself, every other shard has cases of its own, n = 2 and a malformed SHARD are refused, and a shard with no case to run fails.

layers.arrival: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec page models it
layers.quint: n/a: a repository gate rule, not protocol behaviour; no spec models it
layers.contract: n/a: a gate over the repository (pure/rules and CI); it is not contract code
layers.rig: n/a: a gate over the repository, with no system state for the walk

killers.name: R-GATE-SPEC-SHARDS the shards together run each case exactly once, for one shard and for three or more
R-GATE-SPEC-SHARDS the heavy case is shard 0 alone, and every other shard has cases of its own
R-GATE-SPEC-SHARDS no SHARD is the whole suite, and a shard that is not k/n with 0 <= k < n, or n = 2, is refused
R-GATE-SPEC-SHARDS the shard of a case does not move when other cases are added after it
R-GATE-SPEC-SHARDS test.mjs runs the cases of its shard only, and has a heavy case to put in shard 0
